english: Good day, [Ari].
french: Bien le bonjour, [Ari].
russian: Доброго дня, [Ari].
bulgarian: Good day, [Ari].

english: Mistria is such a charming little town, isn't it? Everyone is so fashionable, I feel right at home.
french: Mistria est une charmante petite ville, n'est-ce pas ? Les habitants savent se vêtir. C'est un bonheur pour moi.
russian: Мистрия — такое очаровательное местечко, правда? Все такие модные — чувствую себя как дома.
bulgarian: Mistria is such a charming little town, isn't it? Everyone is so fashionable, I feel right at home.

english: Remember, [Ari], it's not just clothes, it's confidence. There's nothing quite like knowing how well-dressed you are!
french: Les vêtements ne font pas tout, la confiance en soi est également un facteur important. Il faut avoir conscience de sa propre élégance. Tâchez de ne pas l'oublier, [Ari].
russian: Помни, [Ari], одежда не просто ткань, это уверенность. Нет ничего лучше, чем осознание, как хорошо ты выглядишь!
bulgarian: Remember, [Ari], it's not just clothes, it's confidence. There's nothing quite like knowing how well-dressed you are!

english: He's better at tying his cravat than some nobles.
french: Il maîtrise mieux les nœuds de cravate que bien des aristocrates.
russian: Он повязывает платок лучше некоторых аристократов.
bulgarian: He's better at tying his cravat than some nobles.

english: Errol is such a delight to tailor for!
french: C'est un vrai plaisir de confectionner des vêtements pour Errol !
russian: Шить для Эррола — одно удовольствие!
bulgarian: Errol is such a delight to tailor for!

english: I have some excellent pieces in stock today, take a look.
french: J'ai de magnifiques pièces en stock aujourd'hui, n'hésitez pas à y jeter un œil.
russian: У меня сегодня отличные вещи в наличии, загляни.
bulgarian: I have some excellent pieces in stock today, take a look.

english: In the fall, your clothing should be all about layers.
french: L'important en automne, c'est la superposition des couches.
russian: Осенью главное — это многослойность.
bulgarian: In the fall, your clothing should be all about layers.

english: This evening weather is turning a bit brisk, isn't it? It's nearly time to bring out the wool and down!
french: Le temps se rafraîchit le soir, n'est-ce pas ? Les vêtements en laine ou en duvet seront bientôt de mise.
russian: К вечеру холодает, правда? Самое время доставать шерсть и пух!
bulgarian: This evening weather is turning a bit brisk, isn't it? It's nearly time to bring out the wool and down!

english: If you are looking for an article of clothing, you may rest assured that I personally cut and sew every garment you'll find at my booth.
french: Si vous cherchez à vous habiller, sachez que je coupe et que je couds chacun des vêtements qui se trouvent dans ma boutique.
russian: Если ты ищешь новую одежду, не сомневайся: все вещи на моём прилавке пошиты вручную лично мною.
bulgarian: If you are looking for an article of clothing, you may rest assured that I personally cut and sew every garment you'll find at my booth.

english: My stock changes with the week, so if you find something you simply have to see yourself in, don't wait!
french: Mon stock change chaque semaine alors si vous trouvez une pièce que vous souhaitez essayer, ne tardez pas !
russian: Мой ассортимент меняется каждую неделю, поэтому, если что-то приглянулось, не стоит медлить с покупкой!
bulgarian: My stock changes with the week, so if you find something you simply have to see yourself in, don't wait!

english: Greetings and salutations! My name is Louis.
french: Salutations ! Je m'appelle Louis.
russian: Приветствую, привествую! Меня зовут Луи.
bulgarian: Greetings and salutations! My name is Louis.

english: It was such a delight to see Holt today! He has a positively enviable collection of sweaters, and a fanny pack for truly every occasion.
french: Quel plaisir de voir Holt, aujourd'hui ! Sa collection de pulls me rendrait presque jaloux et il a une banane différente pour chaque occasion.
russian: Сегодня повидался с Хольтом — сплошное удовольствие! У него просто завидная коллекция свитеров и сумка на пояс на все случаи жизни.
bulgarian: It was such a delight to see Holt today! He has a positively enviable collection of sweaters, and a fanny pack for truly every occasion.

english: I do enjoy autumn. A light jacket is such a versatile garment this time of year!
french: J'aime l'automne. Une veste légère est le vêtement idéal en cette période de l'année !
russian: Мне нравится осень. Лёгкая куртка в эту пору — вещь универсальная!
bulgarian: I do enjoy autumn. A light jacket is such a versatile garment this time of year!

english: Don't be shy of loud colors, [Ari]. Sometimes a pop of color is just what an outfit needs to come together.
french: Osez les couleurs vives, [Ari]. C'est parfois la petite touche qui parachève une tenue.
russian: Не бойся ярких красок, [Ari]. Иногда яркий акцент — именно то, что завершает образ.
bulgarian: Don't be shy of loud colors, [Ari]. Sometimes a pop of color is just what an outfit needs to come together.

english: [Ari], what a magnificent outfit!
french: Quelle magnifique tenue vous portez là, [Ari] !
russian: [Ari], какой великолепный наряд!
bulgarian: [Ari], what a magnificent outfit!

english: It does sound fun.
french: Voilà qui pourrait être divertissant.
russian: Звучит заманчиво.
bulgarian: It does sound fun.

english: Merri and I were chatting earlier, she suggested I go hunting for older pieces to renew...
french: Je discutais avec Merri, et elle m'a suggéré de chiner des vêtements passés de mode et de les remettre au goût du jour...
russian: С Мэрри мы недавно болтали. Она предложила искать старые вещи, чтобы переделывать их...
bulgarian: Merri and I were chatting earlier, she suggested I go hunting for older pieces to renew...

english: Let me know if you need anything tailored, won't you?
french: Si vous avez besoin d'ajuster des vêtements, n'hésitez pas à faire appel à moi, entendu ?
russian: Если нужно что-то подогнать по фигуре — обращайся!
bulgarian: Let me know if you need anything tailored, won't you?

english: It's wonderful to design things now that are meant to be worn on a busy day outdoors. So much freedom!
french: C'est un plaisir de concevoir des vêtements qui peuvent être portés pour une dure journée de labeur en extérieur. Je suis bien plus libre !
russian: А теперь шью то, в чём можно бегать по делам весь день. Такая свобода!
bulgarian: It's wonderful to design things now that are meant to be worn on a busy day outdoors. So much freedom!

english: In the Capital, I used to design much more... ceremonial clothing.
french: Lorsque je vivais à la capitale, les vêtements que je confectionnais étaient plus... formels.
russian: В столице я создавал куда более... церемониальные наряды.
bulgarian: In the Capital, I used to design much more... ceremonial clothing.

english: What a perfect end to a perfect day! I tell you, this hamlet has the most agreeable weather in all of Aldaria.
french: Cette journée s'achève aussi bien qu'elle a commencé ! Le temps est bien plus doux ici que dans le reste d'Aldaria, croyez-moi.
russian: Идеальное завершение идеального дня! Говорю тебе, в этой деревушке самая приятная погода во всей Альдарии.
bulgarian: What a perfect end to a perfect day! I tell you, this hamlet has the most agreeable weather in all of Aldaria.

english: Ah, the plights and delights of the traveling tailor! I delight in working with new customers, but packing my wares at the end of the day... that's a plight, to be sure.
french: La vie d'un tailleur itinérant est faite de joies et de difficultés. J'adore travailler pour de nouveaux clients, mais ranger mes marchandises en fin de journée... Quelle plaie !
russian: Ах, тяготы и радости кочевого портного! Работать с новыми клиентами — восторг, но собирать товар в конце дня... вот уж тягота.
bulgarian: Ah, the plights and delights of the traveling tailor! I delight in working with new customers, but packing my wares at the end of the day... that's a plight, to be sure.

english: It warms my heart to leave lighter than when I arrived! I hope my pieces bring joy and a touch of style to their new homes.
french: Repartir plus léger qu'en arrivant me réchauffe le cœur ! J'espère que mes créations apporteront élégance et joie à leurs acquéreurs.
russian: Греет душу уезжать налегке! Надеюсь, мои вещи принесут радость и стиль новым владельцам.
bulgarian: It warms my heart to leave lighter than when I arrived! I hope my pieces bring joy and a touch of style to their new homes.

english: As always, it was delightful to see you, [Ari]. I hope to wow you with my selection the next time we meet!
french: Comme à l'accoutumée, ce fut un plaisir de vous voir, [Ari]. J'espère que mes articles vous surprendront toujours lors de mon prochain passage !
russian: Как всегда, рад был тебя видеть, [Ari]. В следующий раз постараюсь поразить тебя своей подборкой!
bulgarian: As always, it was delightful to see you, [Ari]. I hope to wow you with my selection the next time we meet!

english: And so we come to cut the thread of another day. Dressing others... oh, it's an exhilarating life, [Ari].
french: Voilà encore une nouvelle journée qui s'achève. Consacrer sa vie à vêtir autrui est absolument exaltant, [Ari].
russian: И вот мы отрезаем нить ещё одного дня. Наряжать людей... ах, что за восхитительная жизнь, [Ari].
bulgarian: And so we come to cut the thread of another day. Dressing others... oh, it's an exhilarating life, [Ari].

english: Another Market Day comes to its fruitful conclusion! I wish you a splendid and stylish evening, [Ari].
french: Encore un jour de marché qui se termine ! Je vous souhaite une soirée aussi passionnante qu'élégante, [Ari].
russian: Ещё один базарный день подошёл к завершению! Желаю тебе чудесного и стильного вечера, [Ari].
bulgarian: Another Market Day comes to its fruitful conclusion! I wish you a splendid and stylish evening, [Ari].

english: Practicality and fashion must walk hand in hand, especially when you work the earth!
french: Élégance et commodité doivent aller de pair, en particulier si vous travaillez la terre !
russian: Практичность и мода должны идти рука об руку, особенно если работаешь на земле!
bulgarian: Practicality and fashion must walk hand in hand, especially when you work the earth!

english: Before I close up, I must ask... are you making certain to wear appropriate footwear?
french: Avant de fermer boutique, permettez-moi une question... Les chaussures que vous portez sont-elles adaptées à vos besoins ?
russian: Прежде чем закрыться, должен спросить... ты точно носишь подходящую обувь?
bulgarian: Before I close up, I must ask... are you making certain to wear appropriate footwear?

english: Now, where did I put my sewing kit...?
french: Mais où ai-je bien pu mettre mon nécessaire de couture ?
russian: Так... куда же я положил свой швейный набор?..
bulgarian: Now, where did I put my sewing kit...?

english: Evening, [Ari]. I'm just getting packed up.
french: Bonsoir, [Ari]. J'étais justement en train de tout ranger.
russian: Добрый вечер, [Ari]. Я тут собираюсь потихоньку.
bulgarian: Evening, [Ari]. I'm just getting packed up.

english: Repairing your own buttons builds appreciation of the garment, and a patch makes it truly one of a kind.
french: Savoir recoudre un bouton permet d'apprécier d'autant plus un vêtement, tandis qu'une petite retouche le rend unique.
russian: Пришитая пуговица учит ценить вещь, а заплатка делает её по-настоящему уникальной.
bulgarian: Repairing your own buttons builds appreciation of the garment, and a patch makes it truly one of a kind.

english: A bit of advice while I'm packing up, [Ari]. It does a young person good to learn a bit of sewing, no matter their station.
french: Permettez-moi un petit conseil pendant que je range mes affaires, [Ari]. Les jeunes gens devraient apprendre les bases de la couture, quelle que soit leur vocation.
russian: Пока собираю вещи — совет, [Ari]. Молодёжи полезно научиться шить, кем бы они ни были.
bulgarian: A bit of advice while I'm packing up, [Ari]. It does a young person good to learn a bit of sewing, no matter their station.

english: The gentleman has such an eye for color and silhouette! He always surprises me in the ways he mixes and matches my pieces.
french: Ce jeune homme a vraiment l'œil pour les couleurs et les formes ! La façon dont il assortit mes créations me surprend toujours.
russian: У него потрясающее чутьё на цвет и силуэт! Каждый раз удивляет, как он сочетает мои вещи.
bulgarian: The gentleman has such an eye for color and silhouette! He always surprises me in the ways he mixes and matches my pieces.

english: It was good of Ryis to stop by today.
french: Cela m'a fait plaisir de voir Ryis, aujourd'hui.
russian: Риз сегодня заглянул — это было приятно.
bulgarian: It was good of Ryis to stop by today.

english: You know, she was one of my favorite customers in the Capital! It's a dream to be dressing her once more.
french: C'était l'une de mes clientes favorites quand je vivais à la capitale ! Je suis ravi de pouvoir l'habiller à nouveau.
russian: Ты знаешь, в столице она была одной из моих любимых клиенток! Снова её наряжать — мечта.
bulgarian: You know, she was one of my favorite customers in the Capital! It's a dream to be dressing her once more.

english: It was wonderful to see Elsie today. She is a vision, is she not?
french: Ce fut un bonheur de voir Elsie, aujourd'hui. Quelle allure, n'est-ce pas ?
russian: Сегодня увидел Элси — она же просто видение!
bulgarian: It was wonderful to see Elsie today. She is a vision, is she not?

english: Not everyone can incorporate bones in their outfits, but she works it!
french: Tout le monde ne peut pas inclure des os dans ses tenues, mais elle y parvient !
russian: Немногие готовы использовать в своём образе кости, но ей это удалось!
bulgarian: Not everyone can incorporate bones in their outfits, but she works it!

english: That Seridia... simply impeccable fashion sense.
french: Cette Seridia... Elle a un sens de la mode très pointu.
russian: У этой Серидии... Непревзойдённое чувство стиля.
bulgarian: That Seridia... simply impeccable fashion sense.

english: I'd like to think my off the rack selection is second to none, but let me know if you're looking for something special.
french: J'aime à penser que ma collection de prêt-à-porter est déjà exceptionnelle, mais si vous cherchez quelque chose de particulier, n'hésitez pas à me le dire.
russian: Хотя я горжусь своей коллекцией готовой одежды, если хочешь чего-то особенного — просто скажи.
bulgarian: I'd like to think my off the rack selection is second to none, but let me know if you're looking for something special.

english: Spring cleaning should start with your wardrobe. Out with the old, and in with the new!
french: Tout grand ménage de printemps doit commencer par la penderie. Adieu les vieilleries, place au neuf !
russian: Весенняя уборка должна начинаться с гардероба. Старое — прочь, новое — в путь!
bulgarian: Spring cleaning should start with your wardrobe. Out with the old, and in with the new!

english: What effervescent summer weather we've had today! I hope future Market Days bring more of the same.
french: Nous avons profité d'un magnifique temps estival, aujourd'hui ! J'espère que les prochains jours de marché seront comme celui-ci.
russian: Сегодняшняя летняя погода была просто шипуче-прекрасной! Надеюсь, и в будущем базарные дни будут такими.
bulgarian: What effervescent summer weather we've had today! I hope future Market Days bring more of the same.

english: My days, linen and cotton! My nights, canvas and velvet!
french: Pendant la journée, je travaillerai le lin et le coton ! Et la nuit, la toile et le velours !
russian: Днём — лён и хлопок, ночью — бархат и брезент!
bulgarian: My days, linen and cotton! My nights, canvas and velvet!

english: It's still summer of course, but once I return to the workshop I must work on the autumn collection!
french: Nous sommes toujours en été, mais dès mon retour à l'atelier, je m'attellerai à ma collection d'automne !
russian: Лето ещё не закончилось, но в мастерской меня ждёт осенняя коллекция!
bulgarian: It's still summer of course, but once I return to the workshop I must work on the autumn collection!

english: Light, breathable materials are the cornerstone for any summer wardrobe.
french: Un tissu léger et aéré est indispensable pour les tenues d'été.
russian: Лёгкие, дышащие ткани — основа любого летнего гардероба.
bulgarian: Light, breathable materials are the cornerstone for any summer wardrobe.

english: It's not easy to deal with winter weather and be fashionable, but we must soldier on.
french: Affronter l'hiver et ses rigueurs en restant élégant n'est pas chose aisée, mais il faut tenir bon.
russian: Быть модным зимой — непросто, но мы справимся!
bulgarian: It's not easy to deal with winter weather and be fashionable, but we must soldier on.

english: In winter, there's nothing so relaxing as a bit of delicate needlework in front of a roaring fire.
french: L'un de mes plaisirs, en hiver, est de m'installer confortablement devant un bon feu de bois et de faire de la couture.
russian: Зимой нет ничего уютнее, чем изящная вышивка у камина.
bulgarian: In winter, there's nothing so relaxing as a bit of delicate needlework in front of a roaring fire.

english: I'm especially happy to sell out of things in the winter. Wool is a bit heavy to carry, and it means someone in Mistria is keeping warm!
french: J'aime écouler tout mon stock en hiver. Déjà parce que je n'ai pas à rapporter toute cette laine très lourde, mais aussi, car je sais que les habitants de Mistria auront bien chaud.
russian: Особенно рад распродажам зимой. Шерсть тяжела, а значит, кто-то в Мистрии теперь в тепле!
bulgarian: I'm especially happy to sell out of things in the winter. Wool is a bit heavy to carry, and it means someone in Mistria is keeping warm!

english: Oh, you're a thoughtful one. Thank you for thinking of me on my birthday.
french: Oh, comme c'est aimable à vous. Merci d'avoir pensé à mon anniversaire.
russian: О, как трогательно. Спасибо, что думаешь обо мне в мой день рождения.
bulgarian: Oh, you're a thoughtful one. Thank you for thinking of me on my birthday.

english: A =Crystal=! Lovely! What should I use it for? Beads? Buttons? Perhaps an adornment...
french: Un =cristal= ! Qu'il est beau ! Que vais-je en faire ? Des perles ? Des boutons ? Peut-être une parure...
russian: =Кристалл=! Прекрасно! Что бы из него сделать? Бусины? Пуговицы? А может, украшение...
bulgarian: A =Crystal=! Lovely! What should I use it for? Beads? Buttons? Perhaps an adornment...

english: Ah, I suppose I can find some space for it in my bags...
french: Ah, je devrais pouvoir trouver de la place pour ça dans mes cartons...
russian: Хм, думаю, найду местечко для этого в своих сумках...
bulgarian: Ah, I suppose I can find some space for it in my bags...

english: Oh no no no [Ari], this will not do! I can't abide such a thing near my fabrics! A $Fuzzy Moth$ is a harbinger of disaster!
french: Non, non et non, [Ari] ! En aucun cas, cette chose ne doit se poser sur mes tissus. Une $phalène duveteuse$, c'est une catastrophe !
russian: О нет-нет-нет, [Ari], это никуда не годится! Я не потерплю такого рядом с тканями! $Мохнатая моль$ — вестник катастрофы!
bulgarian: Oh no no no [Ari], this will not do! I can't abide such a thing near my fabrics! A $Fuzzy Moth$ is a harbinger of disaster!

english: A most thoughtful gift, [Ari]. Thank you.
french: Quelle prévenance, [Ari] ! Merci.
russian: Это очень продуманный подарок, [Ari]. Благодарю.
bulgarian: A most thoughtful gift, [Ari]. Thank you.

english: You have a generous heart, [Ari]. My thanks.
french: Vous avez un grand cœur, [Ari]. Merci beaucoup.
russian: У тебя щедрое сердце, [Ari]. Прими мою признательность.
bulgarian: You have a generous heart, [Ari]. My thanks.

english: How lovely! There are some flowers that truly accentuate everything around them, don't you think?
french: Quelle délicate attention ! Certaines fleurs embellissent vraiment tout ce qui les entoure, vous ne trouvez pas ?
russian: Как очаровательно! Некоторые цветы способны подчеркнуть красоту всего вокруг, разве нет?
bulgarian: How lovely! There are some flowers that truly accentuate everything around them, don't you think?

english: Splendid! I'll be sure to turn this into something that shines.
french: Magnifique ! Je vais en faire quelque chose de sublime.
russian: Великолепно! Я обязательно превращу это во что-то притягивающее взгляды.
bulgarian: Splendid! I'll be sure to turn this into something that shines.

english: What a charming bloom! =Lilacs= have the loveliest scent, and they make fetching lapel flowers.
french: Quelle fleur magnifique ! Le =lilas= a une odeur si douce et il fait de jolies boutonnières.
russian: Какой прелестный цветок! =Сирень= пахнет восхитительно и идеально смотрится в петлице.
bulgarian: What a charming bloom! =Lilacs= have the loveliest scent, and they make fetching lapel flowers.

english: How beatific! How exceptional! I shan't forget this gift, [Ari]!
french: C'est divin ! Subline ! Jamais je n'oublierai ce cadeau, [Ari] !
russian: Как божественно! Как исключительно! Я не забуду этот дар, [Ari]!
bulgarian: How beatific! How exceptional! I shan't forget this gift, [Ari]!

english: You have my sincerest thanks, [Ari]. I will make most excellent use of this!
french: Je vous remercie infiniment, [Ari]. Je saurai en faire excellent usage !
russian: Прими мою искреннюю благодарность, [Ari]. Я найду этому лучшее применение!
bulgarian: You have my sincerest thanks, [Ari]. I will make most excellent use of this!

english: Materials of this caliber beg to be transformed into the finest of goods! I feel inspired! Touched by the divine! My deepest gratitude to you, [Ari]!
french: Des matériaux de cette nature appellent le raffinement ! L'inspiration vient ! Je suis touché par les dieux ! Je vous serai éternellement reconnaissant, [Ari] !
russian: Материалы такого класса так и просятся, чтобы их превратили в нечто изысканное! Я вдохновлён! Тронут свыше! Моя глубочайшая благодарность тебе, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Materials of this caliber beg to be transformed into the finest of goods! I feel inspired! Touched by the divine! My deepest gratitude to you, [Ari]!

english: Ahh, Mistrian soil truly makes for the finest vintage! Thank you, this is an elegant gift!
french: Ah, les vignobles mistriens produisent des millésimes incroyables ! Merci pour ce cadeau d'une grande finesse !
russian: Ах, почва Мистрии рождает величайшее вино! Спасибо за такой утончённый подарок!
bulgarian: Ahh, Mistrian soil truly makes for the finest vintage! Thank you, this is an elegant gift!

english: I thank you for your kindness.
french: Merci pour votre gentillesse.
russian: Благодарю тебя за доброту.
bulgarian: I thank you for your kindness.

english: Oh, for me? It's a nice thought.
french: Oh, c'est pour moi ? Quelle délicate attention !
russian: О, мне? Это... приятно.
bulgarian: Oh, for me? It's a nice thought.
